summary: Borrow transaction hook snapshots to reduce default writer overhead

replay.detail: No history replay, source extraction, migration or backfill.

schema.detail: No tables, triggers or registry changes.

rules.detail: Admission, authority, raw-gap fences and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Public transaction method signatures remain unchanged. Each outer transaction borrows the installed pair; hook installation remains serialized by the writer loan.

downtime.detail: No production activation or restart required by this library change.

manual.detail: No new operator action or hook bypass.

recovery.detail: Prepare/finalize failures, panics, rollback and SQLite commit errors keep existing behavior. Raw SQL COMMIT is still rejected by managed commit.
